notes.title: Bridge Constructor Studio announced in the Bridge Constrcutor Franchise Sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600594/3e9016ac78ea8b1c478c99beba01916e5fc088cc.jpg[/img]

Dear constructors and engineers,

we are delighted to announce the latest entry in our beloved Bridge Constructor series: [b]Bridge Constructor Studio[/b]!

As you are used to from the series, it is a creative engineering puzzle and sandbox game where you put your engineering skills to the test as you design your own constructions in animated 3D mini-dioramas, then start the simulation to watch your creations face the ultimate stability challenge with large trucks, coaches, monster trucks, etc.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EgB0DeIh-qg

[b]Bridge Constructor Studio[/b] also marks a first for the franchise, as its animated 3D mini-dioramas can be experienced in VR for the first time! But it is also playable in non-VR for all those who don't wan't to build bridges in virtual reality.

Celebrating the announcement, we are holding our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/bridge-constructor-franchise-sale][b]Bridge Constructor Franchise Sale[/b][/url] till May 12 ALL Bridge Constructor games like Bridge Constructor Portal and the latest installment Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead with discounts up to 92% off:

All the best and happy bridge building!

notes.title: Our new project is unveiled: Build like never before with LEGO® Bricktales!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160820/2fc5ab7844457f13f2680de48703e220a9f45aa8.jpg[/img]

Greetings builders,

Finally the bricks are out of the box now and we can unveil our brand new project: [b]LEGO® Bricktales[/b]! After building bridges with our beloved Bridge Constructor franchise for more than 10 years, it felt like a logical step to bring our builder approach to the next level. And believe me, we couldn’t be happier to do this in collaboration with the LEGO Group!

But don't get me wrong, [b]LEGO Bricktales[/b] is not a game about building bridges with LEGO bricks. No, it's much more! It is a digital adventure, where players follow a charming story across 5 different colorful diorama biomes (a dense and lush jungle, a sun-drenched desert, a bustling city corner, a towering medieval castle and tropical Caribbean islands) all fully built from LEGO bricks. As you explore these diverse worlds, we want you to unlock your creativity by building your own solutions to the many puzzles you will face.

[previewyoutube=YJQjQ-nfJRY;full][/previewyoutube]
In each diorama, there are LEGO minifigures who need your help. While exploring the environments, you will discover a variety of construction spots with their own sets of bricks and it’s up to you to figure out a build that will work. Use the intuitive brick-by-brick building mechanic to solve puzzles and bring your solutions to life. The scope of these puzzles range from purely aesthetic creations such as market stands and music boxes, up to functional physics-based puzzles like building cranes, gyrocopters and - of course - bridges. There must always be a bridge. 😉

We are really looking forward to showing you more [b]LEGO Bricktales[/b] in the near future. Follow [b]LEGO Bricktales[/b] here on Steam and sign up to the newsletter on [url=http://bricktal.es][b]bricktal.es[/b][/url] to be the first to know about all our announcements. And of course, if you’re excited about [b]LEGO Bricktales[/b], don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist! ❤️

Until then, friends - stay safe and keep building!
Tri Do Dinh & the ClockStone Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1898290/LEGO_Bricktales/

notes.title: Bridge Constructor is going tabletop with Bridge Constructor: Breaking Point! 🌉
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5213421/f16c419354c99b421591a3a9c7a4b87a9b803039.jpg[/img]

Greetings constructors and engineers,

We have a very special announcement for you today that you would certainly not have expected from the Bridge Constructor series: A decade after the initial launch Bridge Constructor is finally receiving its tabletop adaptation with [b]Bridge Constructor: Breaking Point[/b]! ːsteamhappyː

We have partnered with [url=https://maestromedia.com/][b]Maestro Media[/b][/url] (The Binding of Isaac: Four Souls, Tapeworm), game designer [url=https://twitter.com/jebhavens][b]Jeb Havens[/b][/url] (Critical Role’s Uk’otoa, Z-Man Games' Burrows) and illustrator [url=https://mendolaart.com/artists/charlie-hill-portfolio/][b]Charlie Hill[/b][/url] (Coca-Cola, A&E Network) to offer you [b]Bridge Constructor: Breaking Point[/b] - an easy-to-learn and difficult to master game of tile placement, card management, and pushing your luck.

Suitable for ages 10 and up with 2 - 4 players, the heart of the tabletop game remains true to the original’s concept: engineer the best bridge you can with limited supplies and cross vehicles successfully. The gameplay is half puzzle and half press your luck. Each round you have the choice to pick a bridge tile and either continue to strengthen or rebuild your bridge or cross your vehicles. Choose from Super Light, Light, Medium, or Heavy vehicles that each have their unique points and challenges. Watch out for your fellow engineers though, at any time they might play an event card on you, unleashing devastating damage to your perfectly planned bridge!

[b]Bridge Constructor: Breaking Point[/b] will launch on Kickstarter this September, with retail and additional distribution plans already in the works. To learn more about [b]Bridge Constructor: Breaking Point[/b] and to sign up for updates, please visit [url=http://www.bridgeconstructorgame.com/][b]bridgeconstructorgame.com[/b][/url].

Happy bridge building, all the best and stay healthy!
ClockStone, Headup & Maestro Media


https://store.steampowered.com/app/419080/Bridge_Constructor_Stunts/

notes.title: Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead is unleashed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625296/2ac339b3d5fc4f8a61276ecc656a5ad23119f37e.jpg[/img]

Dear survivors, constructors and engineers,

In August 2020 Geoff Keighley announced a world premiere at the gamescom: Opening Night Live in Cologne:

[i]"Get a load of this next game announcement that I don't think anybody probably saw coming. Go check this out!"[/i]

And yeah, [b]Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead[/b] definitely was the mashup that nobody saw coming. And now - three months later - we are really happy to announce that from now the latest installment of our [b]Bridge Constructor[/b] franchise is releasing for PC, Mac and Linux here on Steam!

Join a group of survivors fighting against hordes of undead walkers and a hostile human community, build bridges and other constructions through bleak landscapes and ruined structures and team up with fan-favorite The Walking Dead characters like Daryl, Michonne and Eugene!

And in case that you are not ready for your next test in civil engineering take a look at our infographic and learn about the different types of bridges. It might come in handy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625296/6908a92ea80b53e7571d0cfd5db2df62956a082c.jpg[/img]

If you wanna share some feedback on the game or you just want to chat with other survivors, please join us on the [b][url=https://discord.gg/U7MXhzm]Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead Discord channel[/url][/b].

So, happy building and surviving to all of you out there!
ClockStone & Headup


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1336120
